elements.name: TextBox 5
elements.text:
# One-Hot
df_enc = df.to_dummies(
  columns=['item_condition_id'])

# Target Encoding (Bayesian)
cat_stats = (
  df.group_by('category_name')
  .agg(pl.col('price').mean()
    .alias('cat_mean'),
    pl.col('price').count()
    .alias('cat_count')))
global_mean = df['price'].mean()
alpha = 10
cat_stats = cat_stats.with_columns(
  ((pl.col('cat_mean')*pl.col('cat_count')
   + global_mean*alpha)
  / (pl.col('cat_count')+alpha)
  ).alias('category_te'))
df = df.join(
  cat_stats.select(['category_name','category_te']),
  on='category_name')

elements.text:
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

model = SentenceTransformer(
    'all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
embeddings = model.encode(
    df['name'].to_list())

pca = PCA(n_components=32)
emb_pca = pca.fit_transform(
    embeddings)

for i in range(32):
    df = df.with_columns(
        pl.Series(f'emb_{i}',
        emb_pca[:,i]))
